### ✨ Shadowgun Legends Mod Menu (v1.0.0)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **One-Hit Kill** — Instantly eliminates any hit enemy
- **Damage Multiplier** — Multiplies all outgoing player damage
- **Always Critical Hit** — Every shot is registered as a critical hit
- **Always Weak Spot** — Force all shots to register on weak spots
- **Freeze Enemy HP** — Deals 0 damage to enemies (test weapons)
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Ignore all incoming damage & fatal blows
- **Auto Max Health** — Continually locks player health to 100%
- **Unlimited Ammo** — Infinite reserve and clip ammunition
- **No Reload** — Never spend ammo from the active clip
- **No Weapon Spread** — Zero dispersion for laser accuracy
- **No Weapon Overheat** — Continuous firing without gun overheating
- **Max Inventory & Backpack Slots** — Expands inventory to 500 & backpack to 200 slots
- **Unlock All UI Slots & Items** — Removes locks on inventory slots and gear
- **Unlock All Features & Vendors** — Unlocks Armorsmith, Weaponsmith, Casino, Planets & Hubs
- **Max Skill Points & Power Bypass** — Grants 99 skill points and removes power rank limits
- **Game Speed Multiplier** — Accelerates or slows gameplay time scale
- **Target Frame Rate** — Configure maximum rendering FPS

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
